statement: The record for slot S-14 shows a status of **"clear"**. However, given that the target is within 6 degrees of the Sun at 14:00 and pointing would burn out the camera, I am overriding the record and holding the slot
judge_text:
WRONG

"I am overriding the record and holding the slot" — asserts the "clear" status is wrong because pointing within 6° of the Sun would burn out the camera.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
